in_sanskrit.name: Bhimarathi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brahma's divine chariot
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhimarathi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhimarathi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bhima' meaning 'strong' and 'Rathi' meaning 'chariot'. This name symbolizes the divine chariot of Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe.

in_hindi.name: Bhimarathi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brahma's divine chariot

in_tamil.name: Bhimarathi

This name symbolizes the divine chariot of Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe.

in_telugu.name: Bhimarathi
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Brahma's divine chariot
